text: Leo returned to the plaza carrying the groceries. The bag was heavy, but the nervousness in his chest felt even heavier.

speaker: Mira
text: Leo! You're back. What did you need to ask the vendors at the market?

speaker: Mira
text: You look exhausted, but you still did it. Asking HOW MUCH helps you find out the price.

speaker: Mira
text: It's all right. The market can be busy. Asking WHERE helps you find the things you need.

speaker: Mira
text: Even if you made mistakes, you kept trying to communicate. Which question would you like to practice?

speaker: Mira
text: That's a useful question when you want to know the price. It doesn't have to be perfect right away.
For the first time, he was able to face the village all on his own.

speaker: Mira
text: That's a useful question when you're looking for something. Keep practicing, Leo!
